name: web-ui
description: Create a tiny static page with a heading, a button and an accessible label.

checks.name: heading, button and accessible label
args: const fs=require('fs');const h=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8');const h1=h.match(/<h1[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/h1>/i);if(!h1||!h1[1].replace(/<[^>]*>/g,'').trim()){console.error('missing non-empty <h1>');process.exit(1)}const b=h.match(/<button[^>]*>/i);if(!b){console.error('missing <button>');process.exit(1)}const tag=b[0];const aria=/\baria-label\s*=\s*["'][^"']+["']/i.test(tag)||/\baria-labelledby\s*=\s*["'][^"']+["']/i.test(tag);const labelled=/\bid\s*=\s*["'][^"']+["']/i.test(tag)&&/<label[^>]*\bfor\s*=\s*["'][^"']+["']/i.test(h);if(!aria&&!labelled){console.error('button has no accessible label');process.exit(1)}console.log('heading, button and label OK')

checks.name: lang and viewport
args: const fs=require('fs');const h=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8');if(!/<html[^>]*\blang\s*=\s*["'][^"']+["']/i.test(h)){console.error('missing html lang');process.exit(1)}if(!/<meta[^>]*\bname\s*=\s*["']viewport["'][^>]*>/i.test(h)){console.error('missing viewport meta');process.exit(1)}console.log('lang and viewport OK')
